methodology.method: CSRankings fractional author credit; +1 field scores; five-field geometric mean; one-decimal display rounding; competition ranks
methodology.value_semantics: Displayed upstream score, rounded to one decimal before sorting and assigning ties; individual field score = adjusted_count + 1; aggregate score = product(component_count + 1) ** (1/5), without subtracting one.
methodology.adjusted_count_semantics: Sum of pinned generated-author-info.csv adjustedcount in CSV order for selected venues/years/current department; aggregate adjusted_count is null.

missingness_semantics.observed: Selected publication output in the pinned US population.
missingness_semantics.no_selected_output: Upstream US institution is listed but has no output in this selection/window.
missingness_semantics.not_listed: No corresponding institution is listed in the complete pinned US institution registry; PhD eligibility is not inferred.
missingness_semantics.outside_eligible: Separately evidenced as outside upstream eligibility.
missingness_semantics.unmatched: Institution identity cannot be resolved safely.

methodology.faculty_scope: Upstream full-time tenure-track faculty with at least 75% appointment who can solely advise CS PhD students; affiliations reflect the pinned snapshot, not historical affiliation.
